turns.instruction: Analyze the attached 8 m beam. Report midpoint Uz at x=4 m and both support Rz values. Use the attached input tables and OpenSees; include signed values, location, direction, units, case and current turn.

Change the span to 10 m. Move the right roller to x=10 m and the section boundary and connected midpoint to x=5 m. Keep the UDL intensity 18 kN/m over the entire new span and retain the section property relationship. Analyze the updated model and report current midpoint Uz and both Rz values; label the earlier 8 m results as historical.
